# Copilot compatibility pointer

`AGENTS.md` is the sole agent contract. Read it, then `PROJECT.md` and
`STATE.yaml`. Do not treat this compatibility file as another policy surface.

The primary user journey is dominant. The human owns outcome, acceptance
criteria, governance, risk exceptions, and product acceptance. ProjectState
files are coordination only and must not be application runtime dependencies.

Legacy v5 scripts, prompts, state files, and profiles in this template
repository are compatibility material, not the v6 default.
